concept.title: Walking, running, cycling and riding
concept.shortdesc: Outdoor active groups and events such as walking, running, cycling and horse riding.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Running, jogging and walking events and groups, such as 5k community events, social runs and club training runs, including volunteering at them.
: Taking part in organised cycle rides, cycling clubs and inclusive or adapted cycling sessions, including volunteering to help at them.
: Riding, driving and other activities with horses and ponies, including riding lessons, pony treks and horse-based therapy or development.
: Taking part in led or self-led walks, health walks and regular walking groups, along with closely related outdoor group activity.
